text: Figure 4.13: Mapping of Category 1 RunnableEntitys to Basic Tasks Extended Task If more than one RunnableEntity is mapped to the same task and the special con- dition (same activation period) does not fit, an extended task is used. If an extended task is used, the entry points to the different RunnableEntitys might be distinguished by evaluation of different OS events. In the scenario above, the differ- ent activation periods may be provided by different OS alarms. The corresponding OS events have to be handled inside the task body . Therefore the RTE-generator needs for each task the number of assigned OS Events and their names.
